paper.title: A Data-Physics Hybrid-Driven Layout Optimization Framework for Large-Scale Wind Farms

public_source_audit.target_paper_code: no public URL stated or found
public_source_audit.target_paper_data: paper states data will be made available on request
public_source_audit.gtde_resource_observation: author page says source for DOI 10.1109/TEVC.2022.3185665 is available by email application rather than public download

paper_provided.pidnn: velocity encoder 4-32-16-8-3 with ELU, separate Ct encoder, Adam, batch 1024, learning rate 0.005, 10000 iterations, regularization 5
paper_provided.training_domain: single NREL 5MW turbine, 30D streamwise by 5D spanwise by 4D vertical, 23 inflow velocities from 3 to 25 m/s and 120000 points per velocity
paper_provided.problem: 7 km square, 80 NREL 5MW turbines, 3D minimum spacing and 12-direction 1989-2002 Danish west-coast wind resource
paper_provided.gtde: population 300, 1000 generations, bottleneck probability N(0.01,0.01), amplification N(0.5,0.1), random targeting probability 0.01 and DE/current-to-best/1 for non-best individuals
paper_provided.anchors: regular layout 1554.20 GWh, GTDE target report 1716.61 GWh, optimized PIDNN 10 m/s power 200.08 MW and RANS check 198.82 MW

conflicts.paper: Eq.12 defines x/y coordinates for 80 turbines while Section 6.3 calls dimension 80
conflicts.resolution: preserve 80 vector-valued turbine genes represented by 160 scalar coordinates

conflicts.paper: Algorithm 1 shows an inner loop and best replacement while prose describes an offspring population
conflicts.resolution: use a frozen generation best and parallel trial evaluation, then ordered selection; declare this HPC completion

reconstruction.training_data: deterministic actuator-disk Gaussian single-wake proxy over the exact paper domain and 23 integer speeds
reconstruction.physics: paper continuity and three momentum residuals with viscosity, actuator-disk source and zero pressure-gradient closure
reconstruction.wind: Figure-6 12-direction six-speed-band digitization normalized to probability one
reconstruction.objective_calibration: one case-wide wake multiplier uses only the reported regular-layout 1554.20 GWh anchor
reconstruction.gtde: binomial CR 0.9, reflected square bounds, summed pairwise 3D violation with 0.001 GWh per square-metre penalty and counter-stable host random events

physical_fes.unit: one complete 80-turbine layout evaluation over the fixed 72 wind states

formal_protocol.training: one paper-profile 10000-step model trained from scratch before optimization
formal_protocol.formal_backend: fastest complete CPU or CUDA backend admitted by H6
